William of Auvergne, De universo (c. 1230)
===========================================
William of Auvergne (c. 1180-1249), Bishop of Paris. De universo — his great treatise on the universe, in two parts: the corporeal universe (Prima pars) and the spiritual universe (Secunda pars: angels, demons, magic, divination — a foundational scholastic demonology). Text: Opera omnia, vol. 1 (Orleans/Paris, 1674). Raw OCR via Internet Archive/Google Books; "Digitized by Google" watermarks and running heads removed; 17th-century Latin OCR noise retained. Complete: Prima pars through Secunda pars de universo spirituali, ending "Deo gratias. FINIS." Public Domain.
